content.value_statement: Production ADK agents need trace, log, and analytics signals without exposing prompt data. This skill guides Cloud Trace, prompt logging, BigQuery analytics, and provider choices.
actual_capabilities: Compares Cloud Trace, prompt-response logging, BigQuery Agent Analytics, and third-party observability tiers.
Explains setup differences for Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, GKE, custom deployments, and local development.
Documents Terraform-provisioned telemetry resources, environment variables, storage buckets, and BigQuery datasets.
Provides verification guidance for Cloud Trace, GCS logging output, BigQuery tables, and analytics views.
Troubleshoots missing traces, logging gaps, privacy mode errors, analytics plugin issues, and telemetry costs.
Links users to relevant ADK documentation for deeper provider-specific setup.
limitations: It assumes a Google ADK and agents-cli project context.
It does not deploy infrastructure or run verification commands by itself.
Prompt-response logging and analytics require GCP permissions, Terraform resources, and configured destinations.
Third-party integrations still require provider accounts, credentials, and provider-specific configuration.

use_cases.title: Plan Production Telemetry
use_cases.description: Choose observability tiers for deployed ADK agents and map each tier to required GCP resources.

use_cases.title: Debug Missing Signals
use_cases.description: Investigate absent traces, prompt logs, or BigQuery events using targeted checks and likely causes.

use_cases.title: Review Logging Privacy
use_cases.description: Understand prompt-response logging modes and reduce content capture before production rollout.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Observability Tier
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose observability tiers for a Google ADK agent. Ask about deployment target, privacy needs, and analytics goals first.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Cloud Trace
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through Cloud Trace setup for my ADK agent. My deployment target is [Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, GKE, or local].

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Prompt Logs
prompt_templates.prompt: Prompt-response logs are missing for my deployed ADK agent. Build a checklist for GCS, BigQuery, IAM, and privacy settings.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Observability Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an observability plan using Cloud Trace, BigQuery Agent Analytics, and one third-party platform. Include trade-offs and rollout order.

output_examples.input: I need to monitor an ADK agent on Cloud Run.
output_examples.output: Recommended path: use Cloud Trace for latency and error flow. Add prompt-response logging only when audit needs justify storage and access controls.

output_examples.input: Prompt logs are not appearing in BigQuery.
output_examples.output: Check that logging is enabled, the logs bucket exists, service accounts can write, and BigQuery exports had time to propagate.

output_examples.input: Which third-party observability tool should my team use?
output_examples.output: Compare hosted versus self-hosted needs, evaluator support, prompt management, and credential handling before selecting AgentOps, Phoenix, MLflow, or another provider.

best_practices: Start with Cloud Trace, then add stored prompt or analytics data only when there is a clear use case.
Keep prompt-response logging metadata-only unless privacy review approves content capture and retention.
Verify IAM, storage destinations, and BigQuery datasets before sending production traffic.
anti_patterns: Enabling prompt content capture without reviewing retention, access controls, and user consent.
Applying Terraform after an SDK-managed Agent Runtime deployment without planning ownership migration.
Treating third-party integrations as interchangeable without checking hosting model, credentials, and data export behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill run observability commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, commands to review, and troubleshooting steps for a user or agent to execute deliberately.

faq.question: Which AI coding tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this require Google Cloud?
faq.answer: Most guidance assumes Google Cloud resources such as Cloud Trace, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, and Terraform-managed infrastructure.

faq.question: Can it help with local development?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains local trace visibility and when prompt-response logging needs a configured logs bucket.

faq.question: Does prompt-response logging store prompt content by default?
faq.answer: The documented scaffolded setup favors metadata-only capture unless content capture is explicitly configured.

faq.question: When should I use another Google agents-cli skill?
faq.answer: Use deployment skills for production rollout work and ADK code skills for Python API implementation patterns.
